headline: Remolona: December rate pause ‘unlikely’
summary: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Eli Remolona Jr. said a pause in rate hikes at the December meeting is possible but unlikely. Growth slowed in the third quarter and inflation is expected to stay elevated next year.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the Philippines' policy rate, which drives local bond yields, the peso and lending conditions.
